mapper.sql: id, source_username, source_local_id, source_server_id, source_message_time, source_category, task_type, send_type, ori_target, ori_msg, pn_original, pn_normalized, brand, product_type, spec, qty, ori_price, offer_price, send_target, send_target_success, send_content, handle_status, send_attempts, last_attempt_at, last_error, matched_inq_json, offer_json, approved_by, approved_at, approval_reason, sent_at, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wechat_offer_task ( source_username, source_local_id, source_server_id, source_message_time, source_category, task_type, send_type, ori_target, ori_msg, pn_original, pn_normalized, brand, product_type, spec, qty, ori_price, offer_price, send_target, send_target_success, send_content, handle_status, send_attempts, matched_inq_json, offer_json, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sourceUsername}, #{sourceLocalId}, #{sourceServerId}, #{sourceMessageTime}, #{sourceCategory}, #{taskType}, #{sendType}, #{oriTarget}, #{oriMsg}, #{pnOriginal}, #{pnNormalized}, #{brand}, #{productType}, #{spec}, #{qty}, #{oriPrice}, #{offerPrice}, #{sendTarget}, #{sendTargetSuccess}, #{sendContent}, #{handleStatus}, COALESCE(#{sendAttempts}, 0), #{matchedInqJson}, #{offerJson}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_offer_task SET handle_status = #{handleStatus}, offer_price = #{offerPrice}, send_target = #{sendTarget}, send_content = #{sendContent}, approval_reason = #{approvalReason}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, sent_at = CASE WHEN #{handleStatus} = 'SENT' THEN COALESCE(sent_at, NOW()) ELSE sent_at END, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE wechat_offer_task SET send_target_success = #{successJson}, handle_status = #{handleStatus}, last_error = CASE WHEN #{handleStatus} = 'SENT' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(#{lastError}, last_error) END, sent_at = #{sentAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE wechat_offer_task SET handle_status = 'APPROVED_PENDING_SEND', last_error = NULL, send_attempts = 0, last_attempt_at = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND handle_status = 'APPROVED_PENDING_SEND'
